name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
label: Quest
description: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am about to bestow a great honor upon you, friend.
Lord Maxwell wishes to reward you for your service to the Argent Dawn!
It has been years since Maxwell has granted audience to outsiders.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are a worthy ally, friend. You shall reap the rewards of your stalwart dedication.
